name: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 50
short_description: An economy design hotel near On Nut BTS with a free tuk-tuk shuttle and a 3.8/5 ALL Rating (195 reviews), 20 minutes from BITEC Exhibition Centre.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 50 is in a Sukhumvit residential area near On Nut BTS Skytrain station, with a free tuk-tuk shuttle service from 9am to 4pm daily. The property holds a 3.8/5 ALL Rating from 195 reviews — the most modest rating among this batch's Sukhumvit properties. It's a 20-minute drive to BITEC Exhibition Centre, with easy expressway access to both airports and Pattaya. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
